messages:
ops-bot: Alert: increased partial responses and socket disconnects on /v1/stream-chat in us-west-2 over the last 30m. spike ~12%. alert id IN-2276549876. ticket INF-4321 auto-created.

alex.k: saw the alert, looking at pod restart rates and connection errors. suspecting KV-cache thrash under long sequences. grabbing logs now.

maria.s: i'll check client reconnect/backoff and handshake timeout. ping me if you need traces or a repro.

suhas: quick repro notes: multi-stream concurrent long outputs cause partial+disconnect pattern. sharing minimal repro below.

jamie: proposed owners: infra = @alex.k, client/SDK = @maria.s, telemetry/alerts = @ruth.p. we need timelines and immediate mitigations.

ruth.p: i will add a streaming metric partial_response_rate and an alert when >5% over 10m. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

alex.k: infra immediate actions: audit connection pool limits, bump keepalive, extend endpoint handshake timeout server-side, add health-check to detect degraded KV cache. i'll own infra remediations. target: 2026-03-29 for initial roll.

maria.s: client changes: switch reconnect to exponential backoff + jitter, extend client handshake timeout 5s -> 12s, add unit tests for timeout/retry. PR target: 2026-03-26.

suhas: i'll post the repro script here and test variations. repro command:
```bash
# repro
python repro_stream.py --concurrency 3 --length 2048
```

alex.k: infra will also run a 2% traffic canary that forces KV cache warming to validate behavior. plan to canary on 2026-03-30 with rollback hooks.

jamie: please add a recurring check-in cadence: weekly for 6 weeks. @ops-bot can you create the reminder?

ops-bot: Reminder created: weekly-check-streaming-remediation starting 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC.

maria.s: we should ensure the server returns explicit 5xx with trace IDs when upstream fails rather than silent partials. SDK should surface those errors to callers.

ruth.p: i'll add trace_id in each chunk and a histogram for chunk gaps so we can correlate partials to backend errs. ETA: 2026-03-27.

suhas: posting repro gist: https://gist.github.com/suhas/repro-stream-22765

alex.k: summary of owners & deadlines: infra:@alex.k (2026-03-29), client:@maria.s (2026-03-26), telemetry:@ruth.p (2026-03-27), repro:@suhas (2026-03-24). infra ticket INF-4321-1 created for the infra checklist.

jamie: i'll track these tasks on the incident board and assign myself as reviewer. :thumbsup:

ruth.p: recommend adding an alert for unrecovered_reconnects > 2% over 5m to catch regressions earlier.

alex.k: adding that to the infra ticket as well.

ops-bot: Incident INF-4321 status -> remediation-in-progress (updated by alex.k).

maria.s: quick note: client PR will include integration tests simulating handshake delays and jitter to validate reconnect behavior.

suhas: i'll run local soak and post results to the ticket once repro is stable.

jamie: schedule an after-action review in the next all-hands week (week 14).

ruth.p: closing loop plan: once telemetry and PRs are live, run 48h canary soak then promote. will report metrics at the weekly check-ins.

ops-bot: Leaving thread open until last_action_done flag is set.
